proofs.text: Write `node_modules/` into `.gitignore`, run init twice and verify the file is unchanged between the two runs, still starts with `node_modules/`, contains `.purlin/runtime/` and carries `.purlin/plugin-root` exactly once. Then write a `pyproject.toml` and a `src/app.py`, run init and verify `[tool.mutmut]` with `source_paths = ["src"]` and `pytest_add_cli_args_test_selection = ["tests"]` was appended after the original text; on a project with no `pyproject.toml` verify `[mutmut]` lands in `setup.cfg` and appears once after two runs. Verify the paths the block names prefer `src` and `tests` when both are there, and name the package directory when there is no `src`

rule_text: A block init appends to a file the project also owns is appended once and never twice, whatever else that file already held

tests.body:
def test_the_gitignore_block_is_added_once(self, project):
        write(project.path('.gitignore'), 'node_modules/\n')
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        first = read(project.path('.gitignore'))
        project.run('--gate', 'tested')
        assert read(project.path('.gitignore')) == first
        assert first.startswith('node_modules/\n')
        assert '.purlin/runtime/' in first
        assert first.count('.purlin/plugin-root') == 1
tests.name: test_a_package_directory_is_found_when_there_is_no_src
reasons: expected value computed by same function as SUT
